gameInstructions: Listen for the signal, gather the tribes, then move to the mountain.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali, and the people began climbing toward Mount Tabor.

lines.speaker: israelite_scout
lines.text: The tribes are gathering. Sisera must not see our movement too soon.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Some answered readily while others held back, but ten thousand followed Barak and Deborah.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Ten thousand men went up under his command, and Deborah also went up with him.

gameSuccess: The tribes gather and reach Tabor without giving away the moment.
name: Ch.3 · Gather at Tabor
